scope: New exploratory reanalysis of two real author-provided CTCF tracking files. Not a full Spot-On replication, a biological population estimate, or evidence for TORUS-specific dynamics.
selection: First lexicographically named cell in each of the two supplied replicate directories, rep1 and rep3. Selected from file inventory before fitting; no cell choice based on numerical outcomes.
identity: U2OS C32 Halo-CTCF, PA-JF646, 1ms 633nm excitation, nominal134Hz. Internal filenames identify acquisition dates2017-02-23 and2017-03-09. Coordinates in micrometers.
pre_fit_inspection: File identity, shapes, first-track schema, provider/Git hashes and timing metadata were inspected before this specification. No distribution/model fitting or train/heldout performance was inspected.
timing: Use recorded per-observation timestamps and verify their consistency with each file's settings.Delay=0.0075s. Author example script says7.477ms, which differs slightly; report this discrepancy explicitly rather than silently substituting a value.
selection_per_trajectory: At each lag, use the first available endpoint pair with exactly that frame-number difference; at most one displacement per trajectory per lag. No displacement-size trimming or velocity-based selection.
split: In rep1, SHA256('ctcf-split-v1:'+trajectory_ordinal), first8hex digits modulo10:0..6=train,7..9=heldout. All lags of a trajectory stay together. All eligible rep3 trajectories form a secondary cell/replicate transfer check; do not refit there.
primary_score: Mean over eligible heldout rep1 trajectories of each trajectory's mean marginal two-dimensional log-density across its available lags. This is a composite marginal prediction score, not a joint independent-increment likelihood.

models.M1: One zero-drift isotropic Brownian displacement population with diffusion D and localization error sigma.
models.M2: Two zero-drift isotropic Brownian displacement components with distinct D values, a shared sigma, and a constant mixture weight. Component labels are descriptive slow/fast, not molecular bound/free labels.
models.observation_law: For each component, vector displacement density exp(-r²/[4(D*(dt-exposure/3)+sigma²)])/[4*pi*(D*(dt-exposure/3)+sigma²)], exposure=0.001s. Both models use the same timestamp, exposure and localization-error convention. This simplified observation model omits defocalization, tracking selection and state transitions.
models.fit: Deterministic multistart L-BFGS-B minimizing negative mean per-trajectory marginal log score. M1 starts D in[.03,.3,3]×sigma in[.02,.05]. M2 starts D1 in[.005,.03,.15]×D2 in[.5,3,10]×weight in[.25,.75],sigma=.035. All starts and failures retained. No component-count tuning.

uncertainty: 1000 paired bootstrap resamples of heldout trajectory-average score differences, seed20261123. This is conditional on fitted parameters and exchangeability of recorded trajectories; it is not biological replicate-level uncertainty or parameter uncertainty.
secondary_diagnostics: Same model parameters scored on rep3 cell01
CDF discrepancy by lag without an independence-based p-value
gates: Verify Git-blob and SHA256 source provenance
Require finite positions/times, strict frame ordering, consistent timestamp step, and at least100eligible trajectories in each scoring partition
Freeze code/spec and input hashes before fitting
Report negative heldout results and all optimizer failures
No individual displacement is called an independent biological replicate
No claim that a two-component fit identifies two molecular states or a physical bound fraction
No14-component tuning or inferred fourteen-layer mechanism
reporting: Small-domain observed-displacement evidence only. The second cell is a distinct recorded replicate, but two cells do not establish population generalization. Missing singletons and defocalization can change observed mixture proportions.
